The Lyre (Lyra) is a stringed musical instrument; Stephen is an accomplished musician and talked about lute music in the previous chapter.
Leo is obviously a diminutive form of Bloom’s name, and there have been repeated associations between Bloom and cats (big and small).
This passage, therefore, might indicate a connection or transference between Stephen/Vega and Bloom/Leo.
